verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a sales-tax compliance SaaS could offer full data export. The evidence documents no export capability. CSV file upload brings data in, the migration guide covers moving from Avalara/TaxJar into Kintsugi, and read endpoints such as Get Filings and Get Nexus are developer building blocks, not a documented bulk export of all data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
